verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents built-in i18n support explicitly designed to translate both content and site navigation/UI strings, with flexible translation workflows (git, Crowdin, etc.) and localized deployment per locale (docusaurus-docs-7, docusaurus-docs-18, docusaurus-docs-24). This is a first-party, dedicated feature rather than a workaround. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically validating the i18n workflow and translated-navigation behavior in practice.
